entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Jane Doe. Order number is VF98765.

Thank you, Jane. I see your order here for the ProFit Jersey, delivered on January 4th. To start the process, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Okay, I understand. So the fit isn't right? Is it perhaps too tight?
Yes. It's too tight. It's not the size I thought it would be.

Not a problem at all. Since you're well within our 90-day return policy for apparel, we can definitely get this sorted for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a different size?
Fine. An exchange, I guess. It's just an annoying process.

I understand, and I'll make this as simple as possible. I've just initiated the exchange for the ProFit Jersey in the next size up. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid return label. You just need to package the original jersey and drop it off with the label attached.
Whatever. When does the new one ship?
As soon as the carrier scans your return package into their system, our warehouse gets an alert and ships your new size, typically within one business day. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
